tasks.short: Coordinate raw product sourcing or collection

steps.what: Collect and verify actual feedstock requirements, supplier availability and receiving constraints
inputs: Planner's actual feedstock demand and approved specification
Supplier's actual availability and collection windows
OPS_SYSTEM: existing plant receiving schedule and capacity records
outputs: Checked quantities, material identities, availability and receiving constraints with gaps marked

steps.what: Compare actual available raw product quantities and collection windows with the declared demand and receiving constraints
inputs: Explicit material-identity, quantity and time-window rules
outputs: Exact feasible matches and unmatched quantity or timing conflicts

steps.what: Coordinate raw product sourcing or collection with the actual supplier, carrier and receiving staff
inputs: Actual supplier, carrier and receiving constraints
outputs: Actual proposed collection arrangement and unresolved issues

steps.what: Prepare the actual collection request and check its complete final material, quantity, window, location and recipients
inputs: Checked source facts and authority limits
outputs: Complete checked final collection request and recipients

steps.what: Send the exact checked collection request to the actual supplier and carrier contacts
inputs: Exact final collection request and recipients checked in s4
outputs: Sent collection request with unresolved matters explicitly pending

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} checks on the actual {ERP}, {PROCUREMENT} and {OPS_SYSTEM} sourcing facts to identify exact quantity and collection-window matches. The technician resolves conflicts with people, completes and checks the actual {DOCS} collection request, then separately sends its exact final version through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated quantity and window comparisons and collection-request fields add handling to actual sourcing coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and request fields can compare explicit constraints and reuse verified arrangement details.
tasks.still_hard: Supplier reliability, material suitability, changing availability and workable collection arrangements require actual people.
tasks.human_edge: The technician coordinates a credible arrangement with the supplier, carrier and plant receiving staff.

ambition.what: Reconsider collection options when actual availability changes.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for supplier-data, planner and receiving-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: spreadsheet constraint comparisons and native request fields can reduce repeated sourcing coordination handling without controlling the plant or choosing unverified material substitutions.

assumptions: Unmeasured sourcing/collection coordination episode with an actual written collection request; not a fabricated report after every call. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

The planner produces actual demand and approved specifications, suppliers provide availability and receiving staff maintain capacity records. s1 counts the technician's collection, capture of comparison fields and verification; missing or stale facts require manual follow-up, not inferred availability.

s2 is the explicit proposed machine comparison and uses exact identities and actual declared constraints only. It does not approve material suitability, create a recipe or operate equipment. Unmatched facts are resolved manually in s3.

s3 covers provisional coordination, with the actual request prepared and completely checked in s4. No contract award, payment, purchase order, material substitution, receiving acceptance or plant-control action is hidden in the request. An arrangement outside delegated authority remains pending for the real authority to review the final version.

Use native comparisons and request templates first. Existing equivalent scheduling or procurement checks are baseline and earn no new saving. The separate immediate send has no saving; edits or recipient changes invalidate its gate.
Gross 22.85 minus 3 incremental upkeep gives 19.85 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
unknowns: Actual manual comparison and request preparation effort
Current planning-system capabilities and coordination authority
research_questions: Which quantity and collection-window comparisons remain manual?
Who maintains the actual receiving-capacity inputs?

already_counted.description: Retained source collection and field capture, actual coordination and complete final-request preparation and checking

incremental.description: Maintain exact material and time-window rules and request fields; check changed supplier and receiving-source formats

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete collection request and supplier/carrier recipients checked in s4; changed facts, wording or destination require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 20 exact comparison plus 2.85 repeated request-field hours = 22.85 gross, minus 3 upkeep = 19.85 net. Existing equivalent planning checks reduce additional benefits.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Planners and receiving staff supply actual requirements and constraints.
Suppliers and carriers confirm actual availability and collection options.
skills_to_grow: Check final collection requests and authority boundaries
role.ambitious_version: A technician with less repeated sourcing comparison work while retaining material judgment, human coordination and control over every external request.
